notes: CAIRN 0.7e - PRE-RELEASE (alpha). Round-11 audit fixes land as one build: the first-boot owner claim now ALWAYS carries the setup token (a stock nginx proxy_pass rewrites Host to the loopback upstream, so 'looks direct-local' can never be trusted to mint an owner - the daemon console prints the token on first boot and the /setup?t=<token> link it shows carries it into the claim; the wizard page may still render on-box without it, exposing only the form); the TLS handshake now runs under the wall-clock deadline reaper like header and body reads (an idle timeout is not a deadline); memory and skill stores get a per-account TOTAL ceiling (8 MB / 2 MB) so no resident can fill the disk or inflate every prompt without bound; a closed, expired, or suspended share now answers the login exactly like a wrong password (no status oracle); ssh_run refuses leading-dash users and fences the destination with --; the OAuth redirect URI is computed for real (trailing-slash strip that actually runs, https-only, empty when unconfigured). INSTALL S2 re-pinned to the v0.7e tag. Upgrade contract unchanged: pre-0.7b builds cannot auto-stage this release (smoke-boot fails closed, live files untouched) - upgrade manually per INSTALL; 0.7b+ auto-update normally. This build is ALPHA: auto-update remains owner-confirmed, databases are never auto-restored, and pre-release builds may break. Crossers from 0.6x: run the migration ferry (cairn-migrate.py, --dry-run first). Nonce 22.
